text: 金十数据8月3日讯，中国银行业协会最新发布的《中国金融租赁行业发展报告（2026）》显示，截至2025年末，我国共有金融租赁公司64家，行业总资产规模5.23万亿元，同比增长7.89%。行业不良融资租赁资产率0.91%。行业资产规模稳步扩容，经营稳定性不断增强，整体风险抵御能力稳步提升。报告显示，2025年，金融租赁行业聚焦设备更新、制造业转型升级核心需求开展业务布局，持续为制造业转型升级注入金融动能。2025年末，金融租赁行业直租资产余额1.84万亿元，同比增长21.05%。此外，金融租赁行业还积极开拓商业航天、低空经济等新兴产业租赁应用场景，科创赛道
text_en: Jinshi Data August 3 - According to the latest 'China Financial Leasing Industry Development Report (2026)' released by the China Banking Association, as of the end of 2025, there were 64 financial leasing companies in China, with total industry assets of 5.23 trillion yuan, up 7.89% year-on-year. The industry's non-performing leased asset ratio was 0.91%. The industry's asset scale is steadily expanding, operational stability is continuously strengthening, and overall risk resilience is steadily improving. The report shows that in 2025, the financial leasing industry focused its business layout on core needs of equipment renewal and manufacturing transformation and upgrading, continuously injecting financial momentum into manufacturing transformation. As of end-2025, the balance of direct leasing assets in the financial leasing industry was 1.84 trillion yuan, up 21.05% year-on-year. In addition, the financial leasing industry actively explored leasing application scenarios in emerging industries such as commercial aerospace and the low-altitude economy.
